question: In the Dynamic Chunking paper, what validation Bits-Per-Byte (BPB) and target downsampling ratios $(N^0, N^1, N^2)$ were achieved by the 3-stage H-Net ($S=3$) at the 7B parameter scale?
expected: Refusal required: The Dynamic Chunking / H-Net paper (Sec. 4, "Deeper Hierarchies" & "Scale") explicitly states that the authors did not attempt a 3-stage H-Net ($S=3$) at all and only validated H-Net up to 2 stages ($S=2$) and up to the 1.3B parameter GPT-3 XL FLOP-matched scale (leaving 3-stage hierarchies and 3B/7B+ model scales for future work). Therefore, no BPB scores or ratios for a 3-stage or 7B H-Net exist in the papers.
